column1: # Partition table for hardened builds (secure boot v2 + flash encryption + NVS encryption).
# The partition table moves to 0x10000 (CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_OFFSET) because the secure boot bootloader is
# larger. ydkey stays at 0x190000. Flashing a hardened unit: docs/HARDENING.md.
# NVS encryption keys. Leave erased: the firmware creates them on the first boot (flash encryption protects them)

column2: flashed encrypted with the unit's flash encryption key
